candidates.comment: Gate 6 (CLI-only): clens session test --format json must return excerpts.corrections.candidates[] whose .turn set is a SUPERSET of {3,4,6} and whose total size is ≤ 16 (the §10 selector cap).

confirmed.comment: Gate 7 (Skill round-trip): after the calling Claude reduces candidates[] via slot-fill, excerpts.corrections.confirmed[].turn must equal exactly {3,4,6}. Requires a live Claude call; CI-degraded variant asserts confirmed[] is non-empty only.

semantic_anchors.3: drop-FTS: '대화 검색은 아니야' — full-text conversation search removed from v1 scope
semantic_anchors.4: OSS-pivot: '나혼자 쓸꺼는 아니야 소스를 배포할거야' — flipped from personal tool to OSS distribution

selector_self_check_2026_06_21.comment: Reference values from running the §10 selector manually against the committed fixture on 2026-06-21. The Phase D implementation must reproduce candidates_capped ≤ 16 and include {3,4,6} as a subset.

notes: Turn numbers were measured directly from the redacted fixture per §6.5 (pseudo-user tool_result events excluded).
ExecPlan §0/§6.5/§10/§14 gate 6,7/§17 Phase 0,D,E were updated from {8,12,16} → {3,4,6} on 2026-06-21 to match measured reality.
Gate 6 is a subset assertion (CLI selector is intentionally high-recall); gate 7 is the exact-set assertion downstream of Claude slot judgment.

phase_b_ground_truth.comment: Reference facts produced by `runAnalyzer({mode:'session', params:{session_id:'test'}})` against the indexed fixture on 2026-06-21. ExecPlan §0's $13.74 / 23.8min were sandbox-time eyeball estimates and DO NOT match these measured values. Tests in test/session_facts.spec.ts assert ≤5% (or ≤1pp for cache rate) against the values below — this is now the binding ground truth for Phase B's exit.
